name: Gyód (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gyód: a crowned shield of blue and red with a yellow rose, ears of grain and a yellow wreath, with blue and yellow mantling and a scroll inscribed GYÓD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gyód arms with mantling and scroll
